 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. On Saturday, November 7, Bayern Munich will be on the road to the MEWA Arena for Bundesliga Matchday 9, where they will be seeking to stay at the top of the table.
 The defending champions come into the fray after a stellar 2-0 Champions League win over Atletico Madrid, but assistant coach Aaron Danks will have to deal with a number of key absences. Mainz, on the other hand, will try to take home advantage after three consecutive losses across all competitions.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bayern sit top of the table with 18 points from eight games, while Mainz sit 10th with 10 points.
 Bayern Munich Confirmed Team News
 Vincent Kompany is not on the touchline, and assistant coach Aaron Danks is still in charge of the team.
 Bayern will be without a number of key first-team players. Luis Diaz, Serge Gnabry, Ismael Saibari and Bara Ndiaye are still unavailable due to injury.
 MUNICH, GERMANY – AUGUST 15: Ismael Saibari and Joshua Kimmich of Bayern Munich help teammate Jamal Musiala after going to ground during the Telekom Cup match between FC Bayern Munchen and RB Leipzig at Allianz Arena on August 15, 2026 in Munich, Germany. (Photo by Alex Grimm/Getty Images)Photo by Alex Grimm/Getty Images
 Jamal Musiala is back in the team after missing a few games with a hamstring injury. But Danks confirmed that Saturday's fixture is too early for the German international, who will take advantage of the international break to get fit.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Harry Kane is likely to spearhead the attack, with Michael Olise and youngster Lennart Karl joining in.
 Mainz Confirmed Team News
 Mainz manager Urs Fischer will also have selection problems heading into the Bayern encounter.
 Phillipp Mwene and Stefan Posch are suspended, and Dominik Kohr is unavailable with an ankle injury. Silas is recovering from a broken leg, and Otto Ruoppi is still in doubt with a knee issue.
 The midfield will be dominated by Nadiem Amiri, Jae-Sung Lee and Kaishu Sano, with attacking options coming from Sheraldo Becker and Phillip Tietz.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mainz vs. Bayern Munich Lineups
 Mainz (3-5-2): Zentner; da Costa, Gruber, Potulski; Caci, Lee, Sano, Amiri, Widmer; Tietz, Becker.
 Bayern Munich (4-2-3-1): Neuer; Laimer, Upamecano, Kim, Stanisic; Kimmich, Pavlovic; Olise, Karl, Brown; Kane.
 Bayern will be looking to continue their impressive unbeaten run away from home, while Mainz will be hoping to break their poor run against the Bundesliga champions.
